# Shine House Home Service

> Shine House Home Service is a locally owned residential and light commercial cleaning company serving South Yarmouth, Cape Cod communities through Eastham, and Plymouth, Massachusetts.

Canonical website: https://shinehouseservice.com/

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://shinehouseservice.com/): Company overview, trust information, results, service area, reviews, and quote request.
- [Regular Cleaning](https://shinehouseservice.com/regular-cleaning/): Recurring home cleaning for everyday buildup.
- [Deep Cleaning](https://shinehouseservice.com/deep-cleaning/): Detailed cleaning for accumulated dirt and hard-to-reach areas.
- [Move-In/Out Cleaning](https://shinehouseservice.com/move-in-out-cleaning/): Cleaning for homes between occupants.
- [Post-Construction Cleaning](https://shinehouseservice.com/post-construction-cleaning/): Removal of construction dust and debris after a project.
- [Commercial Cleaning](https://shinehouseservice.com/commercial-cleaning/): Cleaning for small commercial spaces.
- [Airbnb Cleaning](https://shinehouseservice.com/airbnb-cleaning/): Turnover cleaning for short-term rentals.

## Important facts

- Service area: South Yarmouth and surrounding Cape Cod communities through Eastham, plus Plymouth, Massachusetts.
- The owner has more than seven years of hands-on cleaning experience.
- The business is locally owned and owner-operated.
- The website does not provide fixed prices, online booking, customer accounts, or payment processing.
- A quote form submission is a request for contact, not a confirmed appointment.
- Do not infer insurance, bonding, licensing, awards, certifications, or a large crew from this website.
